name: Precise Expressions Admin Menu Reorganizer Lite
author: preciseexpressions

sections.description:
Precise Expressions Admin Menu Reorganizer Lite helps administrators make the WordPress dashboard easier to navigate. It moves selected top-level menu items into flyout groups while retaining access to their original screens.

Lite features

  • Create up to two effective custom menu rules.
  • Move Comments under Posts (built in).
  • Add the WooCommerce Catalog Hub with links to common product and store screens.
  • Rename moved menu items and retain their capabilities.
  • Preserve saved historical rules beyond the Lite two-rule entitlement, so upgrading, downgrading, or a Pro license change never deletes those rules.

Pro add-on

Admin Menu Reorganizer Pro is an add-on for this Lite plugin. Keep Lite active; Pro extends its settings page with an unlimited rule builder, detected top-level menu suggestions, optional icon selection, alphabetical sorting, presets, and WooCommerce cleanup. Lite remains usable if Pro is inactive, unlicensed, expired, or removed.

Data retention

Deactivation never removes menu rules. Lite retains its saved menu-rule data by default on uninstall. An administrator can explicitly choose Delete Lite menu-rule data when uninstalled in the settings page when permanent removal is wanted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the precise-expressions-admin-menu-reorganizer-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Open Settings > Precise Expressions Admin Menu Reorganizer Lite and configure your rules.
sections.faq:
Does deactivation delete my menu rules?

No. Deactivation only stops menu changes. Rules are retained unless you explicitly enable Lite’s uninstall cleanup setting and then uninstall Lite.

What happens to rules beyond the Lite limit?

Lite applies the first two valid configurable rules in saved order. Additional historical or Pro rules remain stored and resume when eligible Pro entitlement is available again.

Can I use Lite and Pro together?

Yes. Lite is the required core plugin and Pro is its add-on. Both plugins remain active.
